After: all the sushi was eaten. About 12 grape halves (~40 g) remain, so roughly 200 g of fruit was eaten, about 110 kcal. Roughly half the juice remains, so about 120 ml was drunk, about 55 kcal.

Total: about 465 kcal and about 530 g.
